how_observed: Enumerated from the tool registry exposed to THIS Claude Code session (the session's deferred-tool listing), then each tool below that this connector calls had its full JSONSchema fetched via ToolSearch 'select:' and read verbatim. `/mcp` itself is a terminal-dialog command and is unavailable in the desktop Code tab; the registry listing and the fetched schemas are the same underlying catalog and are what is recorded here.
naming: Every tool is exposed as mcp__mcp-tradingview__mcp-tv-<kebab-name>. The reviewed allowlist was written in bare snake_case (get_ohlcv). These are the SAME tools under two spellings; the reconciliation makes the mapping explicit rather than assuming either spelling.

not_present_in_the_live_catalog.finding: NO watchlist tool of any kind is exposed by this server to this session. The connector brick denied eight of them on the strength of the published documentation, including get_active_watchlist and its documented activation/creation side effects. That denial is RETAINED -- a tool absent today can appear tomorrow, and default-deny plus a named denial is the point -- but it is now labelled DOCUMENTED_NOT_LIVE rather than silently implying it was observed on the server.
not_present_in_the_live_catalog.order_execution_or_quote_tools: NONE. This server exposes no order, position, portfolio, execution or options-quote tool at all.

get-ohlcv.returns: aggregate summary and raw bars [{t (unix sec UTC), o, h, l, c, v}]
get-ohlcv.note: bar timestamp key is 't' in unix seconds UTC; normalize.normalize_bars already reads 't'/'time'/'timestamp' and o/h/l/c/v single-letter keys

get-technicals-rating.returns: RSI, Stoch K/D, CCI20, ADX, MACD, Momentum, AO, EMA/SMA 10-200, VWMA, HullMA9, plus 3 Recommend aggregates

get-news.returns: id, title, published (unix), provider, urgency, storyPath, link, permission, relatedSymbols, paywall, total_available, has_more

get-news-story.returns: ast_description, short_description, summary, permission, provider, copyright

get-screener-columns.returns: catalog of screener column names by group

get-earnings-calendar.returns: earnings dates with EPS and revenue consensus

get-economic-calendar.returns: macro events; data since 2003-09-01, forward ~31 days

schema_findings_that_change_the_code: get-earnings-calendar marks `symbols` REQUIRED. A bare earnings-calendar call with no symbols is a schema error, not a market-wide sweep.
get-news-story takes a urn-format `id` that only get-news can supply, so it is inherently a second-hop call.
get-ohlcv bar keys are single letters (t,o,h,l,c,v) exactly as the existing normalizer already accepts.
